common.tagline: AI powered e-commerce site. From image to sales.

home.heroDesc: You can find mostly tech, musical instruments and household bits. Haggle the price anytime with my AI.
home.heroPs: P/S: You may get good deal if you can break it 😏

dialog.m1: That's Terry's Fender Strat — barely played. Asking RM320. 🎸
dialog.m2: Love it. Would you take RM240?
dialog.m3: Cheeky 😄 I can do RM280 — fair for both of us.
dialog.m5: Sold! I'll pack it up today. 📦

demo.desc: Watch a real haggle play out. Terry sets a floor price in private; the agent argues above it, all day, in three languages, and never once tells you where it sits.

offer.title: Name your price
offer.desc: Message a listing at 3am if you like. No “still available?”, no ghosting, no waiting until Terry wakes up.

counter.title: The agent counters
counter.desc: It reads the item, the condition and the market, then argues its corner — inside the margin Terry set.

deal.title: Shake on it
deal.desc: Agree and the price locks straight into Stripe checkout. Held in escrow until the box actually ships.

rules.title: Three things I won't budge on

grading.title: I photograph the scratches
grading.desc: Every listing is graded Like New, Good or Fair with unedited photos. If it has a ding, you'll see the ding before you pay for it.

escrow.title: Your money waits in Stripe
escrow.desc: Payment is held and only released once the item is fulfilled. If something sells twice, the second buyer is refunded automatically.

local.title: Priced and shipped in Malaysia
local.desc: Ringgit, local couriers, tracked to your door. Ask in English, Bahasa Melayu or 中文 — the agent replies in the same language.

deploy.title: Want this running inside your company?
deploy.desc: Nego-lah bukan pet project or mockup. This is a real system taking real payments in Ringgit — and you can plug the whole thing straight into your own shop, your own catalogue, and your own profit margins.

included.listing: Vision pipeline that turns product photos into a named, described, condition-graded listing in three languages
included.agent: Negotiation agent that bargains 24/7 inside the floor price and margin rules you set
included.payments: Stripe checkout, escrow, automatic refunds on double-sale, and tracked fulfilment
included.console: Admin console with revenue analytics, an order pipeline, and full transcripts of every negotiation

q1.label: How can I deploy this for my store or brand?
q1.content: Three easy ways: launch a turnkey white-label storefront under your own domain, plug our AI negotiation engine into your existing Shopify/WooCommerce store via API, or run the whole stack self-hosted via Docker.

q2.label: How does the AI know what price to accept?
q2.content: You set your private floor prices and profit margin rules in the admin console. The AI bargains back-and-forth 24/7 to defend your margins, and never reveals your bottom price to buyers.

q3.label: Does it understand Bahasa Melayu, English, and Chinese?
q3.content: Yes, 100% trilingual. Customers can haggle in BM, English, or Mandarin (even Manglish and rojak talk) — the agent understands and responds fluently in the same language.

q4.label: How do payments and escrow protection work?
q4.content: When a deal is struck, the price is locked into Stripe checkout. Payments are held safely in escrow until tracking confirms doorstep delivery, with automatic refunds if an item sells twice.

q5.label: Can it auto-generate listings from photos?
q5.content: Just upload photos of your items. The built-in vision pipeline detects the product, checks condition, and writes professional titles and descriptions in three languages in seconds.
